beats.say: The cheetah is officially the fastest land animal in the world.
Adult cheetahs typically weigh between 21 and 65 kg.
Four distinct subspecies of cheetah are recognised.
An African subspecies of cheetah was introduced to India in 2022.
The global cheetah population was estimated at 6,517 mature individuals.
Johann Christian Daniel von Schreber described the species in 1777.

facts: The cheetah is the fastest land animal in the world.
Adult cheetahs weigh between 21 and 65 kg.
Four subspecies of cheetah are recognised today.
An African subspecies of cheetah was introduced to India in 2022.
The global cheetah population was estimated at 6,517 mature individuals in 2021.
Johann Christian Daniel von Schreber described the cheetah in 1777.
